the_population.meaning: Exactly one (user, org) pair is configured department_scope='restricted' AND holds admin/ops. Until W-8, PORTAL_DEPARTMENT_SCOPE_BYPASS_ROLES silently made them unrestricted at runtime. W-8 removes that rescue.

the_unanswered_question.why_it_decides_severity: Q6's own note (identity_sql_why_allowed_department_count_matters): if the affected principal has department_scope='restricted' AND allowed_department_count = 0, then with W-8 landed they see NO departments at all — a workspace lockout, not a narrowing. If the count is > 0 they are merely narrowed to their configured departments, which is the intended product behaviour.
the_unanswered_question.status: NEVER READ. The identity query is committed in wave0-authority-census.json Q6.identity_sql and has never been executed against any database.

finding_B_a_promotion_binding_gate_was_c.does_legacy_all_rescue_them: No. ABSENT_PROFILE_ENFORCEMENT='legacy-all' only fails open for principals with NO access profile row. This principal has a profile row that explicitly says 'restricted'. The legacy-all guard does not touch them.
finding_B_a_promotion_binding_gate_was_c.why_this_is_not_a_worker_fix: 03-implementation-qa-sequence.md:3614-3615 — guessing the remediation 'would ship an unannounced product change on top of an unannounced authority change, for the one principal least able to absorb a surprise.' The plan forbids the worker from choosing the remedy. No mitigation was coded this session, deliberately.
finding_B_a_promotion_binding_gate_was_c.generalisation: This is the fifth instance in this program of a recorded state that no instrument re-derives, and the first where the unenforced record was a PROMOTION GATE. Nothing in CI, in the merge path, or in the acceptance rubric reads 'the announcement gate is open' and blocks on it. A gate written only in prose is not a gate.
